IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 503 rates for dedicated pool aurelia-pool-2 (customer: AureliaHealth). Symptoms: ~30% 503s, tail latency > 3s. Incident ID: INC-20260402-7
rachel (oncall): jumping in. pulling up metrics and pool topology now.
diego (SRE): i see retries piling up and TLS handshakes failing with ECONNRESET from tasks on node aurelia-gpu-07. no CPU or GPU spike.
kevin (infra): aurelia-gpu-07 shows MTU mismatch at host-level after maintenance at 03:15 UTC. VXLAN packets > mtu get dropped, fragmentation causing TLS timeouts. i have the output: `ip link show vxlan0 mtu 1400` but host overlay expects 1450.
rachel (oncall): that would break inter-host KV syncs and auth handshakes. starting immediate isolation of aurelia-gpu-07. `redwoodctl node isolate aurelia-gpu-07 --reason maintenance-mtu-fail`
IncidentBot: Node isolation initiated. Estimated 60s to quiesce running tasks.
sara (CSM): pinging AureliaHealth (Priya) now to let them know we are investigating. asking if they're seeing errors from their side.
tom (eng-lead): if MTU is wrong, we should hotfix mtu and restart overlay on that host, but isolate first. also prepare failover to aurelia-standby-pool.
kevin (infra): applying `ip link set dev vxlan0 mtu 1450` on aurelia-gpu-07 and restarting vxlan service. rolling change now.
diego (SRE): after isolation, KV sync retries dropped, 503s to the pool fell from 30% -> 8%. still some clients hitting warm tasks. recommend traffic shift while we validate.
rachel (oncall): enabling failover routing for AureliaHealth: `redwoodctl routes set --customer AureliaHealth --pool aurelia-standby-pool --mode failover`
IncidentBot: Route change applied. Traffic ramp to standby pool in progress. Monitor 30s.
sara (CSM): Priya acknowledged; asked whether this affected other customers in the same VPC. she specifically asked about data isolation.
diego (SRE): initial investigation shows only aurelia-pool-2 nodes were affected; overlay MTU mismatch was host-level config not propagated to other hosts. no cross-tenant routing observed.
kevin (infra): added note: maintenance job that adjusted host networking had a templating bug that set MTU=1400 for hosts with older kernel flags. patching the job.
tom (eng-lead): mitigation status: node isolated and MTU fixed, traffic on standby. track for 30m before returning traffic. also create follow-up tasks.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-20260402-7 state: mitigated -> monitoring. page cleared for oncall handoff.
sara (CSM): requesting a short customer-facing bullet for Priya to email AureliaHealth (one-paragraph). can we get a short RCA draft and proposed credit?
diego (SRE): drafting internal RCA blurb now.
---
diego (SRE): INTERNAL RCA DRAFT:
- Impact window: 2026-04-02 03:12-03:26 UTC 
- Symptoms: intermittent 503 responses and elevated tail latency for requests served from AureliaHealth's dedicated pool. ~30% of requests affected at peak.
- Root cause: A maintenance automation pushed a host network configuration that set an incorrect MTU (1400) on overlay interfaces for a subset of nodes. This caused VXLAN packets to be dropped/fragmented, leading to TLS handshake failures and KV cache sync timeouts for model-serving tasks.
- Mitigation steps: 1) Isolated aurelia-gpu-07 and drained tasks. 2) Corrected MTU to 1450 and restarted overlay service on the host. 3) Failed over AureliaHealth traffic to aurelia-standby-pool until validation. 4) Exported logs and traces for audit.
- Long-term fixes: 1) Fix maintenance templating bug to preserve MTU per-host profile (KEVIN-1, P0). 2) Add preflight network validation that verifies overlay MTU consistency before applying changes (DIEGO-1, P0). 3) Add an automatic overlay health check that triggers failover when inter-node Paxos/KV errors spike (DIEGO-2, P1).
- Customer impact & credits proposal: We estimate ~14 minutes of degraded service for a subset of traffic. Proposed offering: 5% bill credit for impacted billing period + complimentary one-month extended log retention and a 1:1 postmortem call.
---
kevin (infra): added action items and jira refs: INFRA-3421 (templating fix), INFRA-3422 (maintenance preflight), SRE-2190 (health-based failover). linking to INC-20260402-7.
rachel (oncall): exporting logs/traces: `redwoodctl logs export --customer AureliaHealth --start 2026-04-02T03:00Z --end 2026-04-02T04:00Z --out s3://redwood-incident-archives/INC-20260402-7/`
IncidentBot: Logs export started. ETA 12m.
sara (CSM): customer-facing blurb (for Priya):
"Hi Priya, we detected and mitigated a brief disruption to requests served from your dedicated pool between 03:12-03:26 UTC. The incident was caused by an automated maintenance change that set an incorrect network MTU on one host, which briefly impacted intra-pool networking. We isolated the host, corrected the configuration, and failed over your traffic to a standby pool to minimize impact. We estimate the affected window was ~14 minutes for a subset of requests; well apply a credit to your account and follow up with a full RCA and offer a postmortem call. Apologies for the disruption.  Sara (Redwood CSM)"
kevin (infra): approve copy. add a sentence for technical customers confirming no cross-tenant routing occurred.
sara (CSM): added that line and will send. also requesting approval to offer the 5% credit.
finance (ops-bot): auto-ack: Please file a credit request ticket with billing reference and attach incident ID. Finance approval pending manual review.
tom (eng-lead): approve credit offer and postmortem call. also prepare a 1-paragraph exec note: "Mitigated; automation bug fixed; tenant-isolated; remediation plans in progress." keep it short for VPs.
rachel (oncall): handoff note for night shift:
- Status: mitigated, traffic on standby pool, monitoring stable.
- Active items: KEVIN-1 (templating fix), KEVIN-2 (preflight checks), DIEGO-1 (health failover), RACHEL-1 (logs export & tenant audit).
- Customer comms: short blurb sent; full RCA tomorrow and postmortem call offered.
- Slack thread: incidents#INC-20260402-7 for PRs and jira links.

rachel (oncall): handing off to diego for overnight monitoring. I'll be reachable if things regress.
diego (SRE): taking handoff. will validate telemetry and confirm rehoming plan in morning.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-20260402-7 status: monitoring -> resolved (post-mitigation validation complete). Closing thread once RCA posted and credits scheduled.
sara (CSM): filed credit request with ops and scheduled call with Priya for tomorrow at 10:00 PT. closing loop when customer confirms receipt.
-- end of thread --
